messages:
emma: Pasting a screenshot of the Policies card in Console. Thinking about microcopy + chip order + the collapsed header action. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/def/policies-console (frame: card-compact). quick pass?

rajesh: Chip order should be: Region → Retention → Encryption. Users care about where data lives first.

maria: Copy nit: the encryption chip says `Managed`. Too vague. Suggest `Platform-managed (Redwood)` or `Customer-managed (BYOK)` so ownership is explicit.

owen: UX: collapsed row should show an icon action (pencil) with aria-label `Edit policy`. Expanded view keeps primary text CTA. Icon-only helps keep compact list tidy.

liz: Audit logs: we need both machine-friendly fields and a human friendly summary. Machine example: include kms_owner, actor_email, before/after. Human example: short sentence with actor + delta + key type.

katie: Accessibility: header action must be a real button, in tab order, and have at least 44px touch target on mobile. When a row expands, announce via aria-live: `Policy expanded: 90-day retention` so screen reader users know context changed.

emma: Also for region unset state, avoid `Global`. That confuses customers. Use `Region: Not configured` or `Region: Unselected` and make the region picker more discoverable (chevron + `Select region`).

rajesh: chip aria: render each chip as a separate element with aria-label (e.g., `Region: eu-west-1`, `Retention: 90 days`, `Key: Customer-managed (BYOK)`) rather than a single combined string.

maria: microcopy proposals: header tooltip `Edit policy`, chips: `eu-west-1`, `90 days`, `Customer-managed (BYOK)`. Helper text under encryption: `Key stored in customer's KMS, Redwood does not have key access.`

owen: On small widths, move the edit icon into an overflow menu to avoid truncating the policy name. Also ensure the icon has visible focus ring.

liz: Audit event machine-readable example for infra (please copy to ticket):
```
2024-11-07T12:22:09Z policy.update actor=liz@example.com policy_id=pol_321 action=retention:update before=30d after=90d kms_owner=customer region=eu-west-1 source=console
```

liz: Human-readable audit line for UI: `Retention updated from 30 days to 90 days by liz@example.com (Key: Customer-managed (BYOK), Region: eu-west-1)`. Keep it explicit for audits.

katie: a11y follow-up: also add role="status" to the expansion summary container so some screen readers announce it reliably. Test with VoiceOver and NVDA.

audit-bot: Noted: created ticket AUD-412 to add kms_owner and region to audit schema.

emma: Great. Action items: maria to write copy PR, owen to prototype header icon + overflow behavior, katie to run accessibility test pass, rajesh to validate chip aria-labels, liz to open infra ticket with the machine audit example. Ping here if anything reads like we can access customer keys. :thumbsup:
